page.content:
Capcom's tournament saga — Ansatsuken, Shadaloo, and the World Warriors.

How Street Fighter connects

  • Work: Street Fighter II — Street Fighter II is the game that defined the series' lore.
  • Work: Street Fighter 6 — Street Fighter 6 is the modern World Warrior entry.
  • Faction: World Warriors — The World Warriors are Street Fighter's first family of fighters.
  • Faction: Shadaloo — Shadaloo is the crime empire the World Warriors keep fighting.
  • Concept: Ansatsuken — Ansatsuken is the martial art at the core of Street Fighter.
  • Series: Street Fighter Alpha — Street Fighter Alpha is a prequel chapter of Street Fighter.
  • Work: Street Fighter IV — Street Fighter IV revived the World Warriors in 2008.

What is Street Fighter?

Street Fighter is Capcom's fighting-game saga about wandering martial artists, Interpol, and the crime empire Shadaloo. Its lore runs through Ryu and Ken's Ansatsuken, Chun-Li and Guile's hunts for M. Bison, and the World Warrior tournaments from Street Fighter II through Street Fighter 6.

Key threads lead to Street Fighter II, Street Fighter 6, World Warriors, Shadaloo, Ansatsuken and Street Fighter Alpha.
